title: Show CSV rerun progress on Home
summary: Home Live Run now shows CSV rerun rows, current import, last imported file, and processing state from the active stdout tail. Backend worker progress also prefers active-job stdout/stderr tails so CSV rerun activity is not hidden behind stale generic pipeline logs.
reason: CSV reruns were visibly active at the process/log level but Home only showed idle or stale worker text while files were being staged. Operators needed a clear read-only window showing what is being imported, what is being processed, and what is happening.
behavior_before: Home could show idle/stale progress during a CSV rerun, and CSV staging evidence was only visible by opening raw logs or diagnostics tails.
behavior_after: Home Live Run polls the bounded last stdout tail, surfaces CSV row count/import/last imported/processing evidence, and treats CSV stdout evidence as active work while preserving backend-owned mutation boundaries.
manual_validation: In-app browser Home screenshot confirmed Live Run shows CSV rows/importing/last imported/processing status.
rollback_plan: Revert the Home stdout-tail polling/rendering changes in app.js and progressView.js plus the matching tests; the existing diagnostics tail endpoint and raw log window remain available as fallback evidence.
